name: Okura Rui
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c50660]Akito's[/url] classmate and close friend since primary school. He's the straight man of the group, but due to his shy nature he tends to be ignored by his friends. He's rather girly and enjoys feminine hobbies like baking and gardening.
